title: What are the most reliable modern ways to center an element in CSS?
expectedConcepts: CSS Grid centering (display: grid; place-items: center;)
Margin auto centering for block elements with defined width
hints: What two-word CSS Grid shorthand combines align-items and justify-items into one line?
What flex properties handle horizontal and vertical alignment?

codingExercise.instruction: Use CSS Grid to write a single rule on .center-box that centers all its content both horizontally and vertically.
